concern: Target archetype selector retains generic FIN_TECH value rather than specific educational/medical knowledge base categorization.
jtbd: When configuring the platform parameters for CRIE knowledge base, I want the target archetype selector to present domain-accurate medical and educational knowledge base categories, so that the operational context accurately reflects normative medical residency and educational workflows rather than an irrelevant financial archetype.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the control parameters form in mockup.html, When the user inspects the #project-archetype-select dropdown, Then it contains options relevant to medical and educational knowledge base management (e.g. CRIE_MEDICAL_KB, CRIE_ACADEMIC_NORMATIVE) and does not default or restrict exclusively to FIN_TECH.
editInstruction: In design/approved/20261109213511-mockup/mockup.html, locate the <select id="project-archetype-select"> element inside the Control Parameters section. Replace the single <option value="FIN_TECH" selected>FinTech</option> entry with domain-relevant options: <option value="MEDICAL_KB" selected>Medical Knowledge Base (CRIE)</option>, <option value="ACADEMIC_RESIDENCY">Academic Residency Normatives</option>, and <option value="EPIDEMIOLOGY_PORTAL">Epidemiology & Clinical Programs</option>.

concern: Hero preview points to static asset placeholder requiring live data synchronization in production.
jtbd: When viewing the topology preview in production, I want the interface topology to render real-time telemetry and index synchronization state, so that operators can assess current system health instead of looking at an uncoupled static mockup graphic.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a static design mockup file (mockup.html), When evaluating design presentation fidelity, Then static image assets are acceptable representation placeholders, but Given a production deployment, live telemetry WebSocket or polling streams must feed the topology visualization component.
